scope: Compiler-only instrumentation PGO on one immutable fad53 source. Explicit aarch64-apple-darwin target, nightly-2026-03-03, ThinLTO, one codegen unit, four Cargo jobs, incremental0, warnings-as-errors and matching LLVM22.1 profdata. Compiler rebuilding/training are outside program timing.

Eight training programs reproduce unprofiled source/bytecode/Object/metadata. Fourteen paired validation fixtures include seven held-out programs. All program outputs and complete Deflate executable bytes remain identical; no scalar retirement, language/grammar change, weakened checks or new runtime campaign is claimed.

Eight serial ABBA/BAAB source-to-Object runs and eight separate complete source-to-executable runs use the same61 program flags. No concurrent heavy builds, tests, profiling, hashing or archival run during primary cohorts. The complete executable boundary reuses a fixed pinned adapter; source compilation is fresh.

The slow first Object control remains in the means and raw evidence. Frontend and encoding time regressions and footprint movement remain. Screens and standalone cached-link gates are excluded from primary means.
Profile use reports18352 functions without training data and no hash/control-flow mismatch diagnostics; every diagnostic is retained. The fixed training suite does not cover the entire compiler.
This pair predates two frontend schema changes and integrated phase workers. Combined PGO plus current-source/workers is not qualified; no additive gain or sub-ten-second result is claimed.

Seven held-out programs also receive separate eight-run ABBA/BAAB compile cohorts (56 compiles). First numeric control startup is an outlier and remains. Every per-case time, instruction, RSS and block observation is included; no pooled tiny-program percentage is used.

Raw and merged profiles, all commands/build/training/timing logs, source configuration and harness, program/fixture/executable outputs and fixed linker inputs are included. Compiler executables, toolchain, Cargo target/dependency cache and unchanged compiler sources are excluded/pinned. Pure replay validates saved data without rerunning compilation or timings.
